# Provenance of the vendored PDQ code

Copied unmodified from [meta/ThreatExchange](https://github.com/meta/ThreatExchange) at commit `9f627fb1d6d2a4a26c9b5ee1d6ca5e5ccc8e06a2`, directory `pdq/python/` (the `LICENSE` file is the repository root's BSD licence). Fetched 2026-11-22 over HTTPS from raw.githubusercontent.com. Each file's git blob id was recomputed and equals the id in the commit's tree (GitHub git-trees API), so the bytes are the commit's bytes. Not copied: the `tests/` and `tools/` subpackages and `pypdq.cpp`.
